question: Which of the following is the value of sqrt{frac{1-sin 45circ}{1+sin 45circ}}?
solution:
**Given:**

x =** sqrt{frac{1-sin 45circ}{1+sin 45circ}}**

**Formula Used:**

(a+b)(a-b) = a² - b²

**Calculations:**

⇒ As we know, sin 45º = (1)/(sqrt2)

⇒ x =** sqrt{frac{1-sin 45circ}{1+sin 45circ}}=sqrt{(1-frac{1)/(sqrt2)}{1+(1)/(sqrt2)}}=sqrt{(frac{sqrt2-1)/(sqrt2)}{(sqrt2+1)/(sqrt2)}}=sqrt{(sqrt2-1)/(sqrt2+1)}**

Now, conjugate on Right Hand Side

⇒ x = sqrt{(sqrt2-1)/(sqrt2+1)}=sqrt{((sqrt2-1)(sqrt2-1))/((sqrt2+1)(sqrt2-1))}=sqrt{((sqrt2-1)²)/((sqrt2)²-(1)²)}=sqrt{((sqrt2-1)²)/(2-1)}=sqrt{((sqrt2-1)²)/(1)}=sqrt2 - 1

value of 

⇒ sec 45º = sqrt2 and tan 45º = 1

so we can write the above value as

⇒ x = sec 45º - tan 45º

⇒ **Hence, The value of x is sec 45º - tan 45º.**
